title: Step 3 - Decision Tree Visualization: Exploring Splits and Conditions in R

cues.en: Instructor: All right, and now time for the little extra bonus, let's plot the decision tree.
cues.zh: 好，現在來個額外小加碼，畫出決策樹。

cues.en: So in order to have the best interpretation, we're going to remove the feature scaling, and to do this, we're going to clear everything and re-execute the code, but without feature scaling.
cues.zh: 為了方便解讀，要移除特徵縮放，所以先清空所有內容，再重新執行不含特徵縮放的程式碼。

cues.en: So let's do this.
cues.zh: 來做。

cues.en: We're going to clear the data here by clicking on this button here and Yes, then clear the plots here, Yes.
cues.zh: 點這裡的按鈕清除資料，選 Yes，再清除這裡的圖，選 Yes。

cues.en: And then clear the console as well by typing Control+L.
cues.zh: 接著輸入 Control + L，也清空主控台。

cues.en: Here we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: All right, now everything is clear.
cues.zh: 好，現在全部清空。

cues.en: We can re-execute the whole script.
cues.zh: 可以重新執行整份指令碼。

cues.en: So let's do it step by step.
cues.zh: 一步一步來。

cues.en: We're first going to take all the pre-processing step, but without the feature scaling here.
cues.zh: 先取所有前處理步驟，但不包括這裡的特徵縮放。

cues.en: As you can see, I'm not selecting this.
cues.zh: 可以看到我沒有選取這段。

cues.en: All right, so now Commander control + Enter to execute.
cues.zh: 好，按 Command 或 Control + Enter 執行。

cues.en: All good.
cues.zh: 一切正常。

cues.en: And now you can see that if we go to our data set, training set and test set, you can see that the features are no longer scaled.
cues.zh: 現在進入資料集、訓練集與測試集，可以看到特徵已不再縮放。

cues.en: All right, so for example, in the training set we have the real age, I mean with their real values, and the real estimated salaries, the real values.
cues.zh: 例如訓練集中有真正的年齡，也就是原始值，以及真正的預估薪資、原始值。

cues.en: Okay, so nothing scaled now.
cues.zh: 好，現在沒有縮放。

cues.en: Let's select this to fit the decision tree classifier to the training set.
cues.zh: 選取這段，把決策樹分類器擬合到訓練集。

cues.en: So, Commander control + Enter to execute.
cues.zh: 按 Command 或 Control + Enter 執行。

cues.en: Here we go, now it's fitted.
cues.zh: 好，擬合完成。

cues.en: By the way, I'm just going to replace this by Decision tree classification.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，把這裡換成 Decision Tree Classification。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: What we're really interested in right now is to plot the decision tree.
cues.zh: 現在真正感興趣的是畫出決策樹。

cues.en: So we're gonna add a new section here below, and I'm going to call this section Plotting the decision tree.
cues.zh: 所以下面加入新區段，命名為 Plotting the decision tree。

cues.en: And as I told you in the Python tutorial, this is going to take two lines.
cues.zh: 像 Python 教學說過的，只需要兩行。

cues.en: This is very simple, so let's just do it.
cues.zh: 很簡單，直接來做。

cues.en: It's gonna be very quick.
cues.zh: 會很快。

cues.en: Okay, and besides the two lines that we need to write could not be more simple, because indeed what we need to type here is plot, and then in parenthesis, classifier,
cues.zh: 這兩行再簡單不過，因為需要輸入的是 plot，接著小括號中放 classifier，

cues.en: because the classifier here is the classifier that we created here in this part using the R part function of the R part library.
cues.zh: 這裡的 classifier 就是這部分使用 rpart 函式庫的 rpart 函式建立的分類器。

cues.en: And that's all, we just need to type plot (classifier), and that will plot the tree, but without the labels, without the conditions written explicitly.
cues.zh: 就這樣，只要輸入 plot(classifier)，就能畫出樹，但沒有標籤、沒有明確寫出條件。

cues.en: So in order to add these conditions written explicitly, we just need to add below, text (classifier).
cues.zh: 要把條件明確加上去，只需在下方加入 text(classifier)。

cues.en: Here we go, and now it's ready.
cues.zh: 好了，準備完成。

cues.en: Isn't that simple?
cues.zh: 很簡單吧？

cues.en: This only two lines will plot an interpretable decision tree.
cues.zh: 只用這兩行，就能畫出可解讀的決策樹。

cues.en: Let's check it out.
cues.zh: 確認一下。

cues.en: I'm going to select all this, and press Commander control + Enter to execute.
cues.zh: 全部選取，按 Command 或 Control + Enter 執行。

cues.en: And here is the tree.
cues.zh: 這就是樹。

cues.en: So as you can see, we have, at each split, the condition that is generating the split.
cues.zh: 可以看到，每次分割都有產生該分割的條件。

cues.en: So for example, the first split is made based upon the condition age lower than 44.5 years old.
cues.zh: 例如第一次分割的條件是年齡小於 44.5 歲。

cues.en: So that means that if the user is below 44.5 years old, he will go to this subcategory after the split,
cues.zh: 意思是，如果使用者小於 44.5 歲，分割後就進入這個子類別，

cues.en: and if the user is older than 44.5 years old, he will end up in this subcategory of the split.
cues.zh: 如果大於 44.5 歲，就進入這個子類別。

cues.en: And then we have some new conditions.
cues.zh: 接著還有新的條件。

cues.en: So here, a new condition on the other independent variable, the estimated salary, and this condition is estimated salary below $90,000.
cues.zh: 這裡是另一個自變數預估薪資的條件：預估薪資低於 90,000 美元。

cues.en: So what that means is that if the user is younger than 44.5 years old, and has an estimated salary below $90,000,
cues.zh: 意思是，如果使用者年齡小於 44.5 歲，且預估薪資低於 90,000 美元，

cues.en: then according to our decision tree classifier, this user won't buy the SUV because the result here is zero.
cues.zh: 根據決策樹分類器，他不會購買 SUV，因為這裡結果是 0。

cues.en: And if the user is younger than 44.5 years old, and has an estimated salary over $90,000, then according to our decision tree classifier,
cues.zh: 如果小於 44.5 歲，但預估薪資高於 90,000 美元，那麼根據決策樹分類器，

cues.en: this user will buy the SUV because the result here is one.
cues.zh: 他會購買 SUV，因為這裡結果是 1。

cues.en: Okay, and if we go to the other side of the tree, well this other side of the tree first contains all the users that are older than 44.5 years old.
cues.zh: 好，如果到樹的另一側，首先包含所有大於 44.5 歲的使用者。

cues.en: And then we have some new conditions generating new splits, so another condition on the age here, then another condition on the estimated salary.
cues.zh: 接著有新條件產生新分割，這裡又有年齡條件，接著是預估薪資條件，

cues.en: and then again, another condition on the estimated salary.
cues.zh: 然後又一個預估薪資條件。

cues.en: And following yes or no in this conditions, we end up in some final categories, the final nodes of the decision tree where the user is predicted not to buy the SUV for this node,
cues.zh: 依這些條件的是或否，最後進入某些最終類別，也就是決策樹的最終節點。這個節點預測使用者不會購買 SUV，

cues.en: and predicted to buy the SUV for this node, and this node, and this node.
cues.zh: 這個節點、這個節點與這個節點，則預測會購買 SUV。

cues.en: Okay, so that was worth looking at this.
cues.zh: 好，很值得看一下。

cues.en: We sort of explored this decision tree classifier behind the scenes.
cues.zh: 算是探索了決策樹分類器的內部。

cues.en: And what's important to understand now when you are using decision trees is that a big advantage of this classifier is that we can have these very interpretable results,
cues.zh: 使用決策樹時，現在要理解的一項主要優點，就是能得到非常容易解讀的結果，

cues.en: because here on this decision tree plot, we can see everything that's happening.
cues.zh: 因為從決策樹圖能看到整個過程。

cues.en: We can see how the decision tree decides whether a user will be predicted to not buy the SUV or to buy the SUV.
cues.zh: 可以看出決策樹如何決定預測使用者會購買或不會購買 SUV。

cues.en: We clearly see the whole thinking process of the decision tree, and in some way we saw how it learned from the data, how to classify each
cues.zh: 清楚看到決策樹完整的思考過程，某種程度上也看到它如何從資料學習，分類社群網路中的

cues.en: of our user of the social network.
cues.zh: 每一位使用者。

cues.en: All right, so I look forward to seeing you in the next section about random forests.
cues.zh: 好，期待下一節隨機森林見到你。

cues.en: We will implement random forest on Python and R, and I can't wait to show you the final graphic results.
cues.zh: 我們會在 Python 與 R 實作隨機森林，迫不及待展示最終圖形結果。

cues.en: Until next time, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 下次見，在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
